mechanism: Both agents cause arterial vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms (ARB vs. neprilysin inhibitor/ARNI), creating additive hypotensive effects and potential electrolyte/renal complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, use sacubitril/valsartan (which already contains an ARB) instead of adding olmesartan, or monitor blood pressure and renal function closely with dose adjustments.
